placeholder.title: x86 Virtual Machine
placeholder.desc:
Uses WebAssembly v86 to run real x86 code in the browser.
Select an OS and click Start.
placeholder.tech:
Technology: WebAssembly · SharedArrayBuffer · Canvas VGA
Supports: DOS .exe · Linux ELF · ARM (planned)

error.title: Cannot start virtual machine
error.reasons:
Possible reasons:
- HTTPS required (SharedArrayBuffer restriction)
- COOP/COEP HTTP headers required
- Cannot connect to copy.sh

For local dev use:
npx serve -H '{"Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy":"same-origin","Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy":"require-corp"}'
